nubase2020_supplement.citation: Kondev et al. 2021, Chinese Physics C 45, 030001, DOI 10.1088/1674-1137/abddae

supplement_policy.short_lived_missing_nuclides: Require an evaluated 100-percent ground-state beta-minus or beta-plus/electron-capture branch in NUBASE2020, transfer mass to that immediate daughter using the NUBASE atomic-mass ratio, then continue with the pinned decay matrix.
supplement_policy.long_lived_missing_nuclides: Retain the parent when its evaluated half-life exceeds the largest projection horizon.

remaining_decisions: Choose the abundance interpretation horizon or retain time-dependent radionuclides.
Approve the beta-decay rest-mass treatment and publication uncertainty.
Verify decay-data redistribution terms for the release package.
